title: Respect The Amazon
description: Respect The Amazon - JBS is an animated short that takes us into the Amazon rainforest where paradise is shattered when a mechanical army of bulldozers and chainsaws tear through ancient trees, replacing vibrant life with smoke, fire, and profit. At the centre of the destruction sit the Batista Brothers, bloated executives feasting on steak and money, indifferent to the devastation they’ve wrought.

content.about:
## In *Respect The Amazon*, paradise in the Amazon is ravaged by machines driven by profiteering executives until **local defenders rise and spark a global movement**.

Together with Greenpeace International's Respect the Amazon campaign, the animated short calls for us to stand together and demand world leaders to respect and protect our future.

content.heading: Get Involved
content.text: The Amazon sustains life and regulates our climate, but industrial farming and gold mining are destroying it. Demand leaders to halt deforestation, stop funding forest destroyers, and support Indigenous communities now.

content.heading: Hold The Line
content.body:
The Amazon rainforest, home to the most diverse plants and wildlife in the world, faces an urgent threat from industrial-scale agriculture and illegal gold mining. Scientists warn at this pace, the Amazon may soon be reaching a tipping point.

‍

Communities across the Amazon—in the forest and in cities—are standing on the frontlines, pushing back these destroyers. **We can stand with them**. This November at COP30, political leaders, surrounded by corporate lobbyists, will meet in the heart of the Brazilian Amazon, to decide the future of the planet. The message they need to know is clear: **Respect the Amazon**.

content.quote: "Our collaboration with Greenpeace draws on the power of art and activism to drive positive change. Not many people know Big Agriculture is the New Big Oil. JBS is the world’s biggest industrial meat producer, land-grabber and driver of Amazon deforestation for profit. Now is the time to unite and hold the line for the Amazon."
content.cite: Directors Jorik Dozy & Sil van der Woerd

parts.heading: Stop Big Ag
parts.body:
1.5 million hectares. That’s the scale of deforestation tied to JBS’s cattle supply chain, according to investigations by Repórter Brasil and Greenpeace Brazil.

These aren’t isolated cases. This is the business model.

As of 2023, JBS-linked farms cleared 60,000+ hectares even after being flagged for illegal deforestation, according to Mighty Earth.

Big Ag is the new Big Oil.
‍

content.heading: Big Ag Exposed
content.body:
As part of the Respect the Amazon campaign, we created a satirical news interview video where we see 'Giles LeBoeuf' attempt to defend Big Agriculture.

‍

In this video, we expose industrial agriculture's false promises through a cringe-worthy interview where greenwashing talking points literally backfire using dark comedy to demolish Big Ag's credibility.

‍

**Watch the video below!**

content.quote: "The intersection of satirical wit and darker, more urgent underlying narrative is always something that appeals to our creative tendencies. Humour (and farts?) are such a valuable disarming tool in earning your viewer’s attention and trust. The skill is then in gradually provoking a deeper thought process or question on the serious issue at hand…in this instance saving the world from catastrophic climate change and ecological collapse. No pressure."
